The IT Infrastructure and Support Engineer is responsible for implementing, maintaining, securing, and improving the organization's IT infrastructure and cybersecurity environment to ensure reliable, secure, and continuous IT services supporting 24/7/365 airport Baggage Handling System (BHS) operations.

The position provides hands-on technical support across server infrastructure, virtualization, storage, backup and recovery, network infrastructure, endpoint security, system monitoring, and cybersecurity. The role will also support IT infrastructure projects, system upgrades, technology implementations, security enhancements, and IT/OT initiatives while ensuringminimal disruption to business-critical operations.
q: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer
Engineering, Network Engineering, or a related discipline.
 Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in IT infrastructure administration, systems engineering, or IT operations.
 Practical experience managing enterprise server, virtualization, storage, backup, and network environments.
 Experience implementing infrastructure upgrades, system migrations, security hardening, and technology improvement projects.
 Hands-on experience with cybersecurity operations, vulnerability remediation, patch management, and infrastructure security controls.
 Experience supporting business-critical or 24/7 operational environments is highly desirable.
 Exposure to airport systems, baggage handling systems, industrial environments, or IT/OT infrastructure is an advantage.

As a Product & Funnel Optimisation Manager, you will own the optimisation of the local user journey across Binance products. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, CRM, Design, and Marketing teams to improve activation, conversion, retention, and overall user experience.

You will be responsible for identifying funnel bottlenecks, launching experiments, configuring local product experiences, managing market-specific product content and localisation, and using data to drive continuous product improvements. This role requires a combination of analytical thinking, hands-on execution, and strong ownership.
Own the local product experience across Binance products.
Optimise key user journeys, including onboarding, verification, deposits, trading, Earn, and other product funnels.
Configure local product content, banners, landing pages, user-facing assets, and market-specific product settings through internal tools.
Manage product localisation, translations, and language quality across all product touchpoints.
Identify friction points across the user journey and recommend product improvements based on user behaviour and market insights.
Build and maintain dashboards and tracking frameworks to monitor funnel health and product performance.
Analyse product data and user behaviour to identify optimisation opportunities.
Design and evaluate A/B tests together with Product teams to validate product improvements.
Collect feedback from local users and stakeholders and represent market needs to Global Product teams.
Support local rollout of new product features and ensure high-quality execution.
Monitor product KPIs and continuously improve user experience through data-driven recommendations.
2–4 years of experience in Product Operations, Product Marketing, Product Growth, Product Analytics, CRO, or a similar role.
Experience working with digital products, mobile apps, fintech, crypto, SaaS, or consumer technology.
Strong analytical skills and ability to interpret user behaviour and product performance data.
Experience building dashboards, tracking frameworks, and performance reporting.
Experience working with CMS, localisation platforms, or internal product configuration tools.
Comfortable managing product copy, translations, language quality, and market-specific product configurations.
Understanding of user journeys, UX principles, and funnel optimisation.
Strong ownership mindset and attention to detail.

Native Russian and strong English communication skills.
